summary: Frontend-only testing of Alfred AI Phase B 'wire-mesh face' feature on /face route, HUD radial menu integration, FACE control panel, popup launch flow, config persistence, resolution validation, and HUD regressions. All 9 requested test bullets PASS.

test_results_per_bullet./face_renders_wire_mesh_head: PASS — face-window-root present, wireframe-face-canvas contains <canvas>, mode label='AWAITING HUD LINK', link indicator='NO HUD LINK' on initial load.
test_results_per_bullet.lip_sync_bus_link_and_decay: PASS — After ~2s of BroadcastChannel('alfred-face-bus') {type:'state',mode:'speaking',level:0.85} posts every 33ms, mode flipped to 'SPEAKING' and link to 'HUD LINKED'. After stopping for 5.5s, mode reverted to 'AWAITING HUD LINK' and link to 'NO HUD LINK' (stale-link decay confirmed, ~4-5s window).
test_results_per_bullet.camera_toggle_on_face: PASS — face-window-camera-toggle text toggles 'CAM ON' <-> 'CAM OFF'. Gaze indicator shows 'CAM OFFLINE' while CAM ON (headless no camera, expected) and 'CAM OFF' while disabled. No crashes.
test_results_per_bullet.radial_menu_face_entry: PASS — All radial entries (face, spotify, chat, design, workout, workshop) present with correct labels. radial-menu-face text='FACE Wire Mesh Avatar'.
test_results_per_bullet.face_control_panel: PASS — All testids present: face-mode-view, face-launch-btn, face-scan-displays-btn, face-auto-launch-toggle, face-resolution-input, face-permission-status, face-mode-back-btn, face-window-open-status. Back button returns to HUD orb correctly.
test_results_per_bullet.popup_launch_flow: PASS — context.expect_page captured popup at /face. After launch face-window-open-status='● WINDOW ACTIVE' and face-close-btn appeared. Click close → status reverted to '○ WINDOW CLOSED' within ~2.5s.
test_results_per_bullet.config_persistence: PASS — Toggle checked + resolution '1920x1080' Enter saved to localStorage key 'alfred.faceScreen' as {"autoLaunch":true,"resolution":"1920x1080"}. After reload and reopening FACE panel, toggle still checked and input value still '1920x1080'.
test_results_per_bullet.resolution_validation: PASS — Entering 'abc' + blur correctly resets input to 'any'.
test_results_per_bullet.regressions: PASS — Top tabs HUD/CHAT/WORKOUT/DESIGN all clickable. DESIGN renders 39 'sketch-*' testids (sketch-pad, sketch-undo-btn, sketch-redo-btn, sketch-clear-btn, sketch-export-btn ...). SPOTIFY radial entry opens spotify-3d-view; 'subview-back' returns to HUD. WORKSHOP radial entry was earlier confirmed present in radial menu enumeration (radial-menu-workshop OK text='WORKSHOP Self-Coding').

critical_code_review_comments: ChatWindow.tsx is reported to be >2700 lines (very large file). Consider splitting subview routing/effects into separate hooks/components for maintainability.

Console shows repeated 'GL Driver Message: GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warnings from the WireframeFace / MediaPipe pipeline — non-blocking but indicates the face landmarker is doing synchronous readbacks; consider async readback or lower-frequency capture in production.
Many 'ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED' console errors due to backend being intentionally offline in this pod (expected per task brief).
test_credentials: Not applicable — auth gate disabled in this pod.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend dev server reachable at https://a2d678a2-c0e0-4c32-848e-37d606163735.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend supervisor services are EXPECTED FATAL — do not fix. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (networkidle never settles due to polling). For the radial menu, prefer JS click via page.evaluate to bypass actionability flakiness (button.click()) instead of Playwright .click() — direct .click(force=True) timed out intermittently on radial-menu-face after a fresh reload. Always inject `window.open = () => null;` via add_init_script BEFORE reloads when autoLaunch persistence is enabled, otherwise the persisted state opens an unwanted popup tab. Headless browser exposes 'CAM OFFLINE' (no camera) and 'PERMISSION: PROMPT' (no Window Management API) — these are expected non-bugs.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature works as designed.
